text.tspan: USB-C charger + 5 V boost • only charger
TOP VIEW • USB-C up • physical pin sides verified
Hold ~3 s to enter setup mode
1. No battery-voltage divider: D5/GPIO6 is intentionally free.
2. External SETUP button is normally open between D2/GPIO3 and GND.
3. ST7789 is the verified 8-pin module: CS -> D3/GPIO4 and BL -> 3V3.
4. XIAO BAT+ and BAT- stay unconnected. The FM5324GA module is the only charger.
5. Module OUT+ -> switch -> XIAO 5V + MAX98357A VIN. OUT- is system GND.
6. Never connect XIAO USB-C while the power switch is ON. One USB-C at a time.
7. Speaker OUT+ and OUT- go only to the speaker. Neither speaker terminal is GND.
8. Keep the XIAO Sense SD-card slot empty; it shares GPIO7/8/9 with the display wiring.
